custom.guidance: Choose operators and numerical constraints from the current accepted pixels.

emission_nebula.guidance: Locate the intended brightness interval in the current domain; do not substitute the global median for sky.

preferred_chain.purpose: Separate faint filaments and dark transitions in the current domain.
Set the final display level within the shared protection budgets.

high_dynamic_range.guidance: The Agent may select masked dual HDR in the initial proposal from the actual morphology and dynamic range. Protect the final blend.

preferred_chain.purpose: Distribute the initial dynamic range while checking core and stellar color.
Increase envelope separation with explicit current-domain highlight protection.

galaxy_halo.guidance: Protect the nucleus separately from the full-frame histogram and retain faint companions.

preferred_chain.purpose: Reveal disk color while protecting the compact nucleus.
Separate the outer halo and dust lanes in the current domain.
Set the final display level without hiding faint outer structure.

dust_reflection.guidance: Declare bright or dark contrast directions and explicit texture budgets; inspect smooth transitions.

preferred_chain.purpose: Reveal reflection and dust gradients within explicit sky texture budgets.
Separate the measured dust interval while preserving smooth transitions.

star_cluster.guidance: Prefer a full-stars path unless separation has an evidenced benefit; retain the strict shadow limit.

preferred_chain.purpose: Reveal stellar color and the crowded center on the full-stars route.
Set the final display level while retaining peripheral stars and core separation.
